I Built an Agent Loop Guard in 26 Lines — Here Is the Code, the Run, and the Receipt
Standard library only. Watch it block the third identical call, pivot, and stop on a deterministic 'done' — for $0.03.
26 lines • runs with python3, stdlib only
log.append(f'step {step}: {tool} blocked (3rd identical call) -> strategy shift')
if spent > max_usd: # hard cost ceiling
log.append('budget ceiling hit -> escalate to human'); break
step 3: search blocked (3rd identical call) -> strategy shift
The same failing tool call is allowed twice, then blocked — no 48-retry
A hard cost ceiling ($0.25) and step ceiling (15) sit outside the model; the
model cannot talk its way past them.
'Done' is a deterministic verify step returning ok, not the model saying
Every line of the run is a receipt you can paste into a postmortem.
